title: Better Homes
description: A modern, GUI-driven Minecraft home management plugin with MiniMessage support and deep integration with LuckPerms.
body:
# BetterHomes

A simple, modern **/home plugin for Paper** with a clean GUI and LuckPerms support.

---

## 🧭 What is this?

BetterHomes is a lightweight home system that lets players set, manage, and teleport to homes using a **GUI instead of just commands**.

It’s built for servers that want something clean and easy to use without dragging in a huge plugin.

---

## 📸 Preview

![Homes GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8EMCvMte/images/4f4b2afbcadbc798a6da2396aa54688bf20cd158.png)

---

## ✨ Features

* GUI-based home menu (no command spam)
* `/sethome`, `/home`, `/delhome`
* Optional teleport delay
* Block homes in certain worlds (spawn, arenas, etc.)
* LuckPerms support for home limits
* MiniMessage support (colors, gradients, formatting)
* Fast + lightweight (no unnecessary overhead)

---

## 📦 Dependencies

![LuckPerms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LuckPerms/branding/master/banner/banner.png)

* LuckPerms *(only needed for permission-based home limits)*

---

## 🕹️ Commands

* `/home [1-14]` – open menu or teleport
* `/homes` – same as `/home`
* `/sethome [1-14]` – create a home
* `/delhome [1-14]` – delete a home
* `/home reload` – reload config (admin)

---

## 🔑 Permissions

* `home.[1-14]` – eg: home.1 access a specific slot
* `home.*` – access all homes
* `home.admin` – admin commands

---

## ⚙️ Config

Everything is in `config.yml`:

* home limits
* teleport delay
* restricted worlds
* GUI layout + item names
* messages (MiniMessage supported)

---

## 🛠️ Notes

* Built for Paper,Spigot and Purple. 
* Uses Adventure + MiniMessage
* Designed to stay simple and not get in your way

---

If you want something more advanced later (like cross-server homes), this isn’t trying to compete with that — it’s meant to stay clean and focused.

---
